summary: Delve into ISO/IEC 42001 Foundation. Master the principles of information security management and ensure your organization meets international standards.
audienceIntro: This Foundation course is for you if you are already involved with AI-related initiatives and need a structured, standard-based way to talk about AI governance, risk, and lifecycle management. You may not be writing code or building models yourself, but you make decisions about how AI is used, supported, and monitored in your organization. This course is designed for: AI product owners responsible for defining and overseeing AI features. Data and analytics managers coordinating AI and machine learning initiatives. AI project managers supervising delivery of AI-enabled business solutions. Technology governance specialists framing AI policies and accountability models. Risk and compliance analysts evaluating AI-related governance and control gaps. Information security managers integrating AI systems into existing control environments. Digital transformation leads ensuring AI programs align with ISO/IEC 42001 AIMS. Internal auditors beginning to review AI governance and AIMS structures. Consultants advising clients on responsible AI management and standard adoption. Business unit leaders sponsoring AI initiatives and accountable for AI outcomes.
modules: Introduction to AIMS and ISO/IEC 42001 Fundamentals
Artificial Intelligence Management System Requirements and Exam Readiness
prerequisites: There are no prerequisites to participate in this PECB ISO/IEC 42001 Foundation training course. You do not need prior experience with ISO standards or formal artificial intelligence management frameworks. You will benefit most if you are already involved in AI-related projects, data and analytics work, or governance and risk discussions, as the examples and exercises assume active organizational contexts.
